summary.text: Mark Montigny is a Democratic state senator representing the 2nd Bristol and Plymouth District, in office since 1993, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia says he served as an Assistant Majority Leader beginning in the 2015 session.

paragraphs.text: Mark Montigny was born on June 20, 1961.
He attended the University of Massachusetts-Dartmouth and took part in international exchange programs in Africa, Asia, South America, and Europe.
Montigny assumed office in the State Senate in 1993 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee and the Senate Post Audit and Oversight Committee and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Public Service.
